cohort: The study cohort consisted of childbearing-age HIV-infected women in Korea whose medical records were reviewed between January 2005 and June 2017 at four tertiary care hospitals.
finding: The pregnancy rate among HIV-infected women in Korea was lower than the general population, and while several adverse pregnancy outcomes were observed, mother-to-child transmission of HIV was successfully prevented.
gest_age: 24 weeks, 35 weeks, full-term, small for gestational age
